element_1_the_discovery: Avenue Supermarts Ltd presents strong aggregate revenue expansion (+16.2% YoY), yet growth is overwhelmingly propelled by aggressive new store footprint additions while network inventory expanded +85.6% (reaching ₹7,287 Cr), indicating that top-line acceleration masks maturing sales productivity across legacy flagship locations.
element_2_why_it_matters: Top-line revenue driven by new store openings can create an optical illusion of growth that masks maturing or cannibalized sales at existing locations.
Balance sheet inventory expanded by +85.6% to ₹7,287 Cr (holding period at 33.8 days), elevating markdown and obsolescence risks if footfalls normalize.
Substantial lease liabilities and store upfront capital investments require sustained high sales throughput per square foot to preserve store-level EBITDA margins.
Customer receivables remain nominal (0.8 days) due to cash-and-carry retail operations, concentrating operational risk squarely in inventory velocity.
